mapper.sql: SELECT tt.team_id AS team_id FROM label_task_team tt WHERE tt.task_id = #{taskId} AND tt.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT t.team_id AS team_id FROM label_task t WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.team_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT team.team_name ORDER BY team.team_name SEPARATOR '、') AS teamName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tm.team_role) AS teamRole, MAX(join_m.member_role) AS memberRole, MAX(CASE WHEN join_m.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS joined, MAX(join_m.node_key) AS nodeKey, MAX(join_node.node_name) AS nodeName FROM label_team_member tm JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tm.user_id JOIN label_team team ON team.id = tm.team_id AND team.deleted = 0 JOIN () tscope ON tscope.team_id = tm.team_id LEFT JOIN label_task_member join_m ON join_m.task_id = #{taskId} AND join_m.user_id = tm.user_id AND join_m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_task join_t ON join_t.id = #{taskId} AND join_t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_workflow_node join_node ON join_node.project_id = join_t.project_id AND join_node.node_key = join_m.node_key AND join_node.deleted = 0 WHERE tm.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name ORDER BY joined DESC, u.user_id
